The quant functions only reach US filers through sec_facts, so none of them cover the German or Swiss entities, while the market factors cover everything but don't measure exposure. Since market quant is capped at 20%, and none of the exposure functions reach CH or DE, I'll be honest and leave those regions marked as unknown, and I'm weighing whether rd_intensity could fill any part of that gap.

I'm weighing whether to drop the gate, since requiring text evidence would exclude ABB and Siemens, both seed names. The source description of the ESEF filings conflicts with the coverage note, and I'm leaning toward no gate so the German and Swiss names stay in the universe. I'll also sketch a few sub-themes around grid equipment, efficiency and demand response, storage, and smart energy investment.

I'm settling on the KPI list now: a grid automation offering judgement, a grid revenue share extracted from filings, and an efficiency and demand response offering judgement, with storage still to be added.

Now I'm working out the KPI weights, landing on seven KPIs that sum to 100, including a few for grid investment and R&D intensity.
